comment: TableEditor conformance timeline. Rest captures sit at least 0.5 s after the action that precedes them. The delete (t=1.20 = frame 72, .fade) and insert (t=2.20 = frame 132, .automatic) each have a mid-flight capture at +0.15 s = 9 frames at 60 Hz (t=1.35 = frame 81, t=2.35 = frame 141). swipe-actions is omitted: UIKit has no public programmatic reveal of UIContextualAction. Same file drives Tools/oracle2/confprobe (real UIKit, CADisplayLink frame index) and `openhost --app TableEditor` (the port, integer animationTime frames).
